requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must be established by the Central Government.
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government has established the Data Protection Board of India as defined in the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applicable to all entities subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
notes: This requirement is directly derived from the definition of 'Board' in the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Consent Manager must be registered with the Data Protection Board of India and act as a single point of contact for managing consent.
checkable_test: Verify if the entity has a registered Consent Manager acting as a single point of contact for managing consent.
applicability: Applicable to entities that collect and process personal data.
notes: This requirement is directly derived from the definition of 'Consent Manager' in the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must appoint a Data Protection Officer as required by law.
checkable_test: Check if the organization has appointed a Data Protection Officer as required by law.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a Data Protection Officer under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is erased or restricted when no longer needed for the specified purpose.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization provides a specified purpose for data processing and ensures data is erased or restricted when no longer needed.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries who provide a specified purpose for data processing.
notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement for Data Fiduciaries to provide a specified purpose and manage data retention accordingly.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is protected against unauthorized processing, accidental disclosure, or loss.
checkable_test: Check if the organization has implemented measures to protect personal data against unauthorized processing, accidental disclosure, or loss.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a personal data breach and the need for security safeguards.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is retained only for the specified purpose and erased when no longer needed.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization retains personal data only for the specified purpose and ensures erasure when no longer needed.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries who process personal data.
notes: This obligation is tied to the definition of processing and the requirement to retain data only for the specified purpose.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must be notified by the Central Government under section 10.
checkable_test: Check if the organization is classified as a Significant Data Fiduciary and if it complies with the notification requirements under section 10.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a Significant Data Fiduciary and the requirement for notification by the Central Government.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is retained only for the purpose for which it was collected.
checkable_test: Verify if the organization retains personal data only for the purpose for which it was collected.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries processing personal data within India.
notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement that data processing within India must be for the purpose for which it was collected.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must process personal data only for a lawful purpose as defined by the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary's processing of personal data is limited to lawful purposes as per the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data in India.
notes: This obligation is tied to the definition of a Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Every request for consent from a Data Principal must be accompanied by a notice informing the Data Principal of the purpose of processing.
checkable_test: Check if all consent requests include a notice describing the purpose of data processing.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries seeking consent for data processing.
notes: This requirement applies to all data processing activities requiring consent under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must provide a Data Principal with the means to make a complaint to the Board.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary provides clear instructions on how to file a complaint with the Board.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data in India.
notes: This obligation is part of the Data Principal's right to complain under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must accompany or precede a request for personal data with a notice describing the personal data and the purpose of its processing.
checkable_test: Check if all data processing requests include a notice describing the data and its purpose.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data for KYC requirements.
notes: This requirement applies specifically to data processing for KYC under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must inform a Data Principal of the right to withdraw consent and the consequences of withdrawal.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Fiduciary provides information on how to withdraw consent and its effects.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries processing personal data with prior consent.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right of Data Principals to withdraw consent under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must inform a Data Principal of the purpose of processing personal data upon the commencement of the DPDP Act 2023.
checkable_test: Check if the Data Fiduciary provides information on the purpose of data processing to Data Principals who gave consent before the Act's commencement.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries who processed data before the DPDP Act 2023 came into effect.
notes: This requirement applies to Data Principals who gave consent prior to the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Data Fiduciary shall provide the Data Principal with the option to access the notice in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
checkable_test: Check if the notice provides the option to access in English or any language from the Eighth Schedule.
applicability: All data fiduciaries required to provide notice to data principals.

requirement: Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous, with a clear affirmative action, and limited to the necessary personal data for the specified purpose.
checkable_test: Verify that consent is specific, informed, and limited to necessary data for the specified purpose.
applicability: All data fiduciaries seeking consent for processing personal data.

requirement: Consent given for processing personal data shall not include any invalid terms, such as waiving the right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Board of India.
checkable_test: Check if any part of the consent includes invalid terms, such as waiving the right to file a complaint.
applicability: All data fiduciaries seeking consent for processing personal data.

requirement: Every request for consent shall be presented in clear and plain language, with the option to access the request in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
checkable_test: Verify that consent requests are presented in clear and plain language with the option to access in English or any language from the Eighth Schedule.
applicability: All data fiduciaries seeking consent for processing personal data.

requirement: The Data Principal shall have the right to withdraw consent at any time, with the ease of doing so being comparable to the ease with which such consent was given.
checkable_test: Check if the withdrawal of consent is as easy as the initial consent was obtained.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data based on consent.

requirement: The Data Principal shall have the right to access the notice in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, along with the contact details of the Data Protection Officer or authorized person.
checkable_test: Verify that the notice includes the option to access in English or any language from the Eighth Schedule and provides contact details of the Data Protection Officer or authorized person.
applicability: All data fiduciaries required to provide notice to data principals.

requirement: The withdrawal of consent shall not affect the legality of processing of personal data based on consent before its withdrawal.
checkable_test: Check if the withdrawal of consent does not affect the legality of processing before withdrawal.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data based on consent.

requirement: If the Data Principal withdraws consent, the Data Fiduciary may stop enabling the use of the service for placing orders but may not stop processing for goods already ordered and paid for.
checkable_test: Verify that withdrawal of consent does not affect the processing of goods already ordered and paid for.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data for fulfilling supply orders.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must cease processing personal data of a Data Principal who has withdrawn consent, unless processing is required or authorized by law.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that processing must cease upon withdrawal of consent, unless required by law.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the withdrawal of consent and cessation of processing.

requirement: A Data Principal may give, manage, review, or withdraw consent through a Consent Manager.
checkable_test: Verify if the document allows a Data Principal to manage or withdraw consent through a Consent Manager.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the right of the Data Principal to manage or withdraw consent.

requirement: A Consent Manager must be accountable to the Data Principal and act on her behalf in accordance with prescribed obligations.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that the Consent Manager must act on behalf of the Data Principal in accordance with prescribed obligations.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries using a Consent Manager.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the accountability of the Consent Manager to the Data Principal.

requirement: A Consent Manager must be registered with the Board in accordance with prescribed conditions.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that the Consent Manager must be registered with the Board in accordance with prescribed conditions.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries using a Consent Manager.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the registration of the Consent Manager with the Board.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must prove that a notice was given and consent was obtained in accordance with the Act and rules, if a question arises in a proceeding.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that the Data Fiduciary must prove that notice was given and consent was obtained in accordance with the Act and rules.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement to prove that notice and consent were properly given.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary may process personal data only for the specified purpose for which the Data Principal has voluntarily provided her data, unless she has indicated non-consent.
checkable_test: Verify if the document states that data may be processed only for the specified purpose unless the Data Principal has indicated non-consent.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data of Data Principals.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the purpose limitation of data processing.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must process personal data only for purposes explicitly permitted by law, including providing services, fulfilling legal obligations, and safeguarding employer interests.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies permitted purposes for data processing as outlined in the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: All data fiduciaries processing personal data for permitted purposes.
notes: This requirement covers multiple clauses that define permissible data processing purposes under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall protect personal data in its possession or under its control by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the use of reasonable security safeguards to prevent data breaches.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: In the event of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary shall notify the Board and each affected Data Principal of the breach.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies procedures for notifying the Board and affected Data Principals in case of a data breach.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall erase personal data upon the Data Principal withdrawing her consent.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the obligation to erase personal data upon withdrawal of consent.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall retain personal data for a period of ten years beyond the closing of an account for compliance with legal requirements.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the retention of personal data for a period of ten years beyond account closure for legal compliance.
applicability: Data Fiduciaries subject to legal retention requirements.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall no longer retain personal data once the purpose for which it was collected has been fulfilled.
checkable_test: Verify that the document specifies the obligation to delete personal data once the purpose of processing has been fulfilled.
applicability: All Data Fiduciaries processing personal data.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must cease processing personal data if the Data Principal does not exercise her rights for a prescribed period.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies a time period for inactivity before ceasing data processing.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries who process personal data based on user inactivity.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must establish a time period for the retention of personal data and erase it upon expiry.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a time period for data retention and erasure.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries who retain personal data for a specific period.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must publish business contact information for a Data Protection Officer or a person who can answer questions from Data Principals.
checkable_test: Verify if the document provides contact details for a Data Protection Officer or a representative.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries that have a Data Protection Officer.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must establish an effective mechanism to redress grievances of Data Principals.
checkable_test: Check if the document outlines a grievance redressal mechanism.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must obtain verifiable consent from the parent or lawful guardian of a child or person with disability before processing their personal data.
checkable_test: Verify if the document requires verifiable consent from a parent or guardian for children or persons with disabilities.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing data of children or persons with disabilities.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must not process personal data of children if it is likely to cause detrimental effects on their well-being.
checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits processing personal data of children that may harm their well-being.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing data of children.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must not engage in tracking or behavioral monitoring of children or targeted advertising directed at children.
checkable_test: Verify if the document prohibits tracking or targeted advertising of children.
applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries processing data of children.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must ensure that processing of personal data of children is done in a manner that is verifiably safe.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies measures to ensure verifiably safe processing of children's data.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries processing children's personal data.
notes: This clause establishes a general obligation for data fiduciaries to ensure safe processing of children's data, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: The Central Government may exempt a data fiduciary from certain obligations if it ensures verifiably safe processing of children's data.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the age threshold for exemption from obligations related to children's data processing, if any.
applicability: Applies to data fiduciaries subject to government exemption notifications.
notes: This clause allows for exemptions from certain obligations if the government determines processing is verifiably safe, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must appoint a Data Protection Officer.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the appointment of a Data Protection Officer.
applicability: Applies to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This clause mandates the appointment of a Data Protection Officer for significant data fiduciaries, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: Significant data fiduciaries must conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the conduct of periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments.
applicability: Applies to significant data fiduciaries.
notes: This clause requires significant data fiduciaries to conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: Data principals have the right to request access to their personal data from the data fiduciary.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the right of data principals to request access to their personal data.
applicability: Applies to data principals who have given consent to data fiduciaries.
notes: This clause establishes the right of data principals to request access to their personal data, which can be checked against governance documents.

requirement: A Data Principal shall have the right to correction, completion, updating and erasure of her personal data for the processing of which she has previously given consent.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides a mechanism for data principals to request correction, completion, updating, and erasure of their personal data.
applicability: Applies to all data principals who have given consent for the processing of their personal data.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right to erasure and correction of personal data under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary shall erase personal data upon receipt of a request for erasure unless retention is necessary for a specified purpose or for compliance with law.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies that data fiduciaries must erase personal data upon request unless retention is required for a specified purpose or legal compliance.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries handling personal data subject to erasure requests.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right to erasure under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal shall have the right to grievance redressal mechanisms provided by a Data Fiduciary or Consent Manager.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides grievance redressal mechanisms for data principals regarding data fiduciary or consent manager actions.
applicability: Applies to all data principals who have interacted with data fiduciaries or consent managers.
notes: This obligation is tied to the right to grievance redressal under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary or Consent Manager shall respond to grievances within a prescribed period.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies a time limit for responding to grievances raised by data principals.
applicability: Applies to all data fiduciaries and consent managers handling grievances.
notes: This obligation is tied to the grievance redressal process under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: A Data Principal must exhaust the opportunity of redressing her grievance under this section before approaching the Board.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides a process for resolving grievances internally before allowing appeals to the Board.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals follow internal grievance mechanisms before seeking external redress.

requirement: A Data Principal shall have the right to nominate any other individual to act on their behalf in the event of death or incapacity.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows for the nomination of a representative to act on behalf of the Data Principal in case of death or incapacity.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals can designate a representative to manage their data rights in case of incapacitation.

requirement: The term 'incapacity' includes inability to exercise rights due to unsoundness of mind or infirmity of body.
checkable_test: Check if the document defines 'incapacity' to include mental or physical conditions that prevent the exercise of data rights.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement clarifies the definition of incapacity for the purpose of data rights.

requirement: A Data Principal must not register false or frivolous grievances or complaints with a Data Fiduciary or the Board.
checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits the registration of false or frivolous grievances or complaints.
applicability: Applies to all Data Principals.
notes: This requirement ensures that the grievance process is not abused by submitting false complaints.

requirement: The Central Government may restrict the transfer of personal data by a Data Fiduciary to countries outside India.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides for the possibility of government-imposed restrictions on cross-border data transfers.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement allows the government to impose restrictions on data transfers to foreign jurisdictions.

requirement: The applicability of Indian laws providing higher protection for data transfers outside India is not restricted by this section.
checkable_test: Check if the document acknowledges that higher protections for data transfers outside India may be provided by existing Indian laws.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement ensures that existing Indian laws on data transfer protections remain applicable.

requirement: The Central Government may notify certain Data Fiduciaries, including startups, that are exempt from specific data protection provisions.
checkable_test: Check if the document allows for the exemption of certain Data Fiduciaries, including startups, from specific data protection provisions.
applicability: Applies to all Data Fiduciaries.
notes: This requirement allows for the exemption of certain entities from specific data protection obligations.

requirement: The Data Protection Board of India must include at least one expert in the field of law.
checkable_test: Verify if the Data Protection Board of India includes at least one legal expert.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement ensures the Board has legal expertise to fulfill its duties.

requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Data Protection Board shall not be varied to their disadvantage after their appointment.
checkable_test: Verify if the terms of the Chairperson and Members are not varied to their disadvantage after appointment.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement protects the terms of the Board members from being altered unfavorably.

requirement: The Chairperson and other Members of the Data Protection Board shall hold office for a term of two years and be eligible for re-appointment.
checkable_test: Verify if the term of office for the Chairperson and Members is two years with eligibility for re-appointment.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement establishes the term and re-appointment eligibility for Board members.

requirement: The Chairperson or a Member of the Data Protection Board shall resign upon the Central Government's permission or upon expiry of three months from the notice of resignation.
checkable_test: Verify if the resignation of the Chairperson or Member is effective upon Central Government's permission or after three months.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement outlines the conditions for resignation of Board members.

requirement: The Chairperson and Members of the Data Protection Board shall not accept employment with any Data Fiduciary against whom proceedings were initiated.
checkable_test: Verify if the Chairperson and Members of the Board accept employment with Data Fiduciaries against whom proceedings were initiated.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement prevents conflicts of interest by prohibiting employment with entities under investigation.

requirement: The Central Government shall be informed of any defect in the appointment of a person acting as the Chairperson or other Member of the Board.
checkable_test: Verify if the Central Government is informed of any defect in the appointment of the Chairperson or Members.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement ensures transparency in the appointment process of the Board members.

requirement: The Board may appoint officers and employees as necessary for the efficient discharge of its functions, with prior approval from the Central Government.
checkable_test: Verify if the Board has the authority to appoint officers and employees with prior Central Government approval.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement allows the Board to function efficiently by appointing necessary personnel.

requirement: The Chairperson, Members, officers, and employees of the Data Protection Board shall be deemed public servants under the Indian Penal Code.
checkable_test: Verify if the Chairperson, Members, officers, and employees of the Board are deemed public servants under the Indian Penal Code.
applicability: Applicable to the Data Protection Board of India.
notes: This requirement grants the Board members and staff the status of public servants, ensuring accountability and legal protections.

requirement: The Board has the authority to investigate complaints made by Data Principals regarding breaches of obligations by Data Fiduciaries or Consent Managers and impose penalties as provided by the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document outlines procedures for investigating complaints and imposing penalties for breaches by Data Fiduciaries or Consent Managers.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary or Consent Manager.
notes: This obligation is derived from the powers granted to the Board under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Board or its officers shall not prevent access to any premises or take into custody any equipment or item that may adversely affect the day-to-day functioning of a person.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that prohibits preventing access to premises or taking custody of equipment that affects day-to-day operations.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary or intermediary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the restrictions on the Board's powers under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may require the Board and any Data Fiduciary or intermediary to furnish information as it may call for.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that allows the Central Government to request information from the Board, Data Fiduciaries, or intermediaries.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary or intermediary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the government's authority to request information under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may, in the interests of the general public, direct any agency of the Central Government or any intermediary to block access to information generated, transmitted, received, stored, or hosted in any computer resource, after giving an opportunity of being heard to the Data Fiduciary.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that allows the Central Government to direct intermediaries to block access to information in the public interest.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is an intermediary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the government's authority to block access to information under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may require the Board to advise on the manner in which the notice given by the Data Fiduciary to a Data Principal shall inform her, under sub-section (1) of section 5.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that outlines the manner in which notices to Data Principals must be provided under section 5(1) of the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the Central Government's authority to set notice requirements under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: The Central Government may require the Board to advise on the manner in which the notice given by the Data Fiduciary to a Data Principal shall inform her, under sub-section (2) of section 5.
checkable_test: Check if the governance document includes a policy that outlines the manner in which notices to Data Principals must be provided under section 5(2) of the DPDP Act 2023.
applicability: Applicable to any organization that is a Data Fiduciary.
notes: This obligation is derived from the Central Government's authority to set notice requirements under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must undertake other measures as specified under sub-clause (iii) of clause (c) of sub-section (2) of section 10.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the other measures that Significant Data Fiduciaries must undertake as per the referenced sub-clause.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Principals must make a request to the Data Fiduciary for erasure of personal data in the manner specified under sub-section (3) of section 12.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the manner in which Data Principals can request erasure of personal data as per the referenced sub-section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Principals and Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must respond to grievances within the period specified under sub-section (2) of section 13.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the time period within which grievances must be responded to as per the referenced sub-section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must give notice to the Board or affected Data Principal in case of a personal data breach under sub-section (6) of section 8.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the obligation to notify the Board or affected Data Principal in case of a personal data breach as per the referenced sub-section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must provide a fair account of details necessary for specific and informed consent in clear and plain language.
checkable_test: Verify if the document specifies the requirement to provide a fair account of details in clear and plain language for informed consent as per the referenced section.
applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Provide a clear and accessible communication link for accessing the website or app.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a specific and accessible link to the website or app in the document.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries required to provide such links.

requirement: Provide a description of means for withdrawing consent with ease comparable to the ease of giving consent.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a clear and accessible method for withdrawing consent.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries requiring consent.

requirement: Provide a description of means for making a complaint to the Board.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a clear and accessible method for lodging a complaint with the Board.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries.

requirement: Register as a Consent Manager with the Board by furnishing required particulars and documents.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a registration process for Consent Managers as per the Board's requirements.
applicability: Applicable to entities registering as Consent Managers.

requirement: Register the applicant as a Consent Manager and publish the details on the Board's website.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a process for registering Consent Managers and publishing their details.
applicability: Applicable to entities registering as Consent Managers.

requirement: Ensure Consent Managers adhere to conditions and obligations as specified in Part B of the First Schedule.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of obligations for Consent Managers as specified in Part B of the First Schedule.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers.

requirement: Take corrective measures if the Board identifies nonadherence to conditions and obligations by a Consent Manager.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a process for addressing nonadherence by Consent Managers.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers.

requirement: Issue an order for reasons to be recorded in writing if it is necessary to act in the interests of Data Principals.
checkable_test: Verify the presence of a process for issuing orders in the interests of Data Principals.
applicability: Applicable to all Consent Managers.

requirement: A Data Fiduciary must implement reasonable security safeguards to protect personal data in its possession or under its control, including any processing undertaken by it or on its behalf.
checkable_test: Check if the document explicitly states that the organization implements reasonable security safeguards to protect personal data.
applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries handling personal data.
notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for reasonable security safeguards under the DPDP Rules 2025.

requirement: Implement appropriate data security measures, such as encryption, obfuscation, masking, or the use of virtual tokens mapped to personal data.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies encryption, obfuscation, masking, or virtual tokens for securing personal data.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Implement appropriate measures to control access to computer resources used by the data fiduciary or data processor.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies access control measures for computer resources.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Maintain visibility on the accessing of personal data through appropriate logs, monitoring, and review to detect unauthorized access.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies logging, monitoring, and review mechanisms for detecting unauthorized access.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Implement reasonable measures for continued processing in the event of confidentiality, integrity, or availability of personal data being compromised, such as data-backups.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies data-backup or continuity measures for data compromise.
applicability: Applicable to all data fiduciaries and processors handling personal data.

requirement: Retain logs and personal data for a period of one year for detecting unauthorized access, investigating it, and ensuring continued processing, unless required by law.

checkable_test: Check if the document requires submission of reports from Data Protection Impact Assessments and audits to the Board.

requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must ensure that technical measures, including algorithmic software, used for processing personal data do not pose risks to Data Principals' rights.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires verification that technical measures used for processing personal data do not pose risks to Data Principals' rights.
applicability: Applicable to Significant Data Fiduciaries.

requirement: Central Government may restrict transfer of personal data and traffic data outside India, subject to recommendations of a committee.
checkable_test: Check if the document specifies restrictions on transferring personal data and traffic data outside India.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must prominently publish information on their website or app to enable Data Principals to exercise their rights under the Act.
checkable_test: Check if the document requires prominent publication of information to enable Data Principals to exercise their rights.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must provide Data Principals with details of the means to exercise their rights under the Act.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must specify the particulars required to identify Data Principals when exercising their rights.

notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to specify identification details for exercising rights.

requirement: Data Principals may make requests to the Data Fiduciary to whom they have previously given consent for processing of their personal data, using the means and furnishing the particulars required by such Data Fiduciary for the exercise of such rights.

applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Rules 2025.
notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to allow Data Principals to make requests using required means and identification details.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries and Consent Managers must prominently publish on their website or app a grievance redressal system for responding to Data Principal grievances within ninety days.
checkable_test: Check if the document provides a prominently published grievance redressal system with a ninety-day response period.

notes: This requirement is directly tied to the obligation to publish a grievance redressal system with a specified response period.

requirement: Data Fiduciaries must meet requirements specified by the Central Government for transferring personal data outside the territory of India.

requirement: Data fiduciaries must provide information to the Central Government upon request for purposes specified in the Seventh Schedule.

notes: This obligation applies when the Central Government requests information for specified purposes.

requirement: Disclosure of information requested by the Central Government may be restricted if it affects India's sovereignty, integrity, or security.

notes: This obligation applies when disclosure of information may prejudice India's sovereignty, integrity, or security.

requirement: Electronic records must not be altered in a way that affects their original content or integrity.
